justification: The most specific overlap is that both include anthropomorphic elements with arms/hands and repeated decorative patterning, with some profile creature or wing/bird-like forms rendered by incised outlines. The biggest difference is that B is a coherent standing winged human figure holding objects beside vegetation, whereas A is a much more schematic surface of separated animal signs, bands, and abstract motifs with no comparable single figural scene or object-holding relationship.
